truth: This is an isolated fictional preview under /design-lab-v3. No production session, database, request, offer, payment or notification is changed.
The supplied screenshots are functionality inventory, not composition or material approval. No new repository inspection, capture or performance result is claimed here.
Maya's default disconnected Instagram state produces no Instagram handle or connected icon. A TapMart handle must not masquerade as a connected Instagram identity.
Person work is ownership-matched. A photographed latte or business reference does not become Maya's submission through visual adjacency.
US$240 /month is Eli's asking rate for Rear doors. It is neither a full-wrap quote, an accepted offer nor the US$300/month Personal campaign opportunity.
Request opens composition. It does not select Maya for a campaign, send an invitation or imply she accepted. The local review boundary remains explicit.
The live Loyalty strip initially projects 10 members and 6 who came back from the approved local model. It updates only when that working model changes, never because discovery media animates.
Loyalty permanently belongs to Business → Loyalty. Home supplies a discovery entrance, not a sixth destination, fourth campaign type or alternate ownership architecture.

Filter order is matched lead inventory, Loyalty strip, matched continuation. If a filter excludes a lead record, collapse that record's slot rather than keeping a nonmatching result or an empty spacer. Whenever a lead car is present, its entire action band precedes Loyalty.
Phone initial scope is Maya, Eli's vehicle and Nora. Desktop adds Eli as an independently inspectable person. Do not repeat records or expand the scope merely to fill space.
Use September 17, 2026, 10:00 AM CDT as the existing Loyalty fixture clock. Viewing this marketplace never advances that clock.
All brace expressions below are data bindings, never literal UI. Resolve their ownership, values and visible text before capture; unsupported optional facts are absent.
spec.two_second_read: Maya's face and work lead. A real car placement follows. Choose a person or inspect a vehicle; manage returning customers after discovery.
spec.thesis: Business Home is an open selection spread, not a directory: Maya is encountered at human scale through her portrait and authored work, while Eli's vehicle occupies a separate photographic field with a precisely scoped asking rate. Unequal proportions and object-specific openings replace the current compact, shared-baseline inventory. The bright canvas stays uncovered; depth appears only at navigation and active inspection controls. Loyalty remains a quiet operational strip after the completed lead discovery spread, connecting acquisition to return without taking over the marketplace.

every_visible_string: This destination is outside the V3 lab.
copy_budget.target: Hard maximum: 35 visible words in the first 390×844 viewport at default text size, after fonts and images settle. The specified default has a planned 24 UI words before any readable image lettering, verified optional handle or supported attention count; this is an inventory calculation, not a rendered result. Aim for 27 to 33 only when real bound content earns those words. Do not add filler to reach that target. Full initial inventory retains the direction's 65 to 90 phone and 80 to 110 desktop pressure targets; report actual totals even when lower. Count repeated occurrences, controls, money, notices and legible media lettering. Measure filters, expanded tasks, errors, paused and reduced-motion states separately. Required disclosures and 200% text zoom are not capped.

states.what_changes: For you and Home are selected. Maya has no disconnected-state replacement label. Her two work samples are visible. Eli's photograph begins below her completed action band; its text and Loyalty remain farther down in ordinary flow.

People renders Maya, then the strip, then the eligible person continuation. Cars renders Eli's complete vehicle composition, then the strip, then only supported matching continuation. Nearby uses the selected fixture city without requesting device location. Each filter retains its own scroll anchor. No-result inventory shows No matches and Choose another filter. before the strip; it does not fabricate a result.

The same portrait and selected work become a larger open composition. Keep identity visible while inspecting work. Actual eligibility, completed work and reviews appear below the media, only when supplied. No empty rating object or administrative inspector appears.

Use the existing working request model. The person is fixed; type selection contains only Recreate and Story. Required fields, financial basis, deadlines, rights and type-specific obligations remain visible before review. Do not prefill US$75 from an unrelated public opportunity. Missing required data blocks review.

Render the complete supplied request review on opaque paper. This is the recording endpoint, not Request sent or Accepted. The live-send boundary is not an enabled action. Back preserves the draft; closing a dirty draft requires Discard this draft? with Keep editing and Discard draft.

Open the intact photograph and separate placement plan. Rear doors is the only selectable zone unless further zones are backed by the same vehicle fixture. The asking rate occupies opaque paper immediately beside the selected zone, outside the lens control rail.

Retain the selected vehicle and supported placement. The existing offer requirements include real dates, duration, monthly basis, installation, applicable costs, proof and removal obligations where supplied. Asking rate remains distinct from entered offer pay. Review cannot fabricate a sent or accepted offer.
The baseline resolves to 10 members · 6 came back. Render current projections, not separately authored display numbers. No Live badge or reward count is added to this marketplace strip.

Render only the applicable branch: no program uses the brand mark, Turn visits into rewards. and Create program; draft uses Draft · Free coffee and Continue setup; live-zero uses 0 members · 0 came back and View QR. Preserve the same open strip and insertion slot. Never show seeded counts in these branches.

Pause changes only the motion-control label and presentation behavior. Under reduced motion, default to stationary presentation. All discovery, request, vehicle and return actions remain fully usable; no workflow state is withheld.

visible_strings: This destination is outside the V3 lab.
states.what_changes: A failed image retains its reserved dimensions and identity, with a plain labelled fallback. Retry appears only when supported. Missing media blocks media-dependent inspection, not unrelated navigation. Unsupported destinations open the inherited explicit notice rather than production.

engineering_notes: Use real React/CSS and existing V3 local providers. Keep all implementation and evidence isolated to V3; leave production and V2 untouched. Inspect actual repository paths before updating FILE_MAP.md.

Resolve exact work filenames, ownership, image dimensions, subject-safe crops, connected states and rate scope in docs/design-lab-v3/MEDIA_MANIFEST.json before implementation approval. The wildcard inventories are not asset-selection permission.

Typography is bundled DM Sans. Lead person name: 28px/32px, weight 500, tracking -0.03em on phone; 32px/36px on desktop. Money: 36px/40px phone, 44px/48px desktop, weight 600, tabular numerals. Actions: 14px/20px at 600. Facts: 13px/18px. Navigation and lab context: at least 12px/16px. Forms and obligations: 16px/24px.

Ink is #17221E; secondary text is #59655D at full opacity. Focus is a 2px #315E49 outline with 3px offset on light surfaces. The selected filter has a 2px ink underline and a programmatic selected state, not color alone.

Base order: canvas z0, media z10, opaque reading surfaces z20, navigation lens z40, floating controls z50. Modal scrim is z60; lift the complete active working-paper task into z70 and its compact header into z80. Base navigation becomes inert and visually covered during full-height tasks.

No nested backdrop filters. Maximum two active lens regions on phone and three on desktop; target visible blur area below 20% of the viewport. This surface normally has one. Desktop sidebar, rate bands, Loyalty and person media never use blur.

Use the genuine backdrop lens for active controls. The source-image optical-rim duplication technique is reserved for the controlled public stages, not added to this marketplace. No pointer-following highlight is needed here.

Snapshot start and end geometry once per transition. Animate transform and opacity on bounded media/control layers; preserve the image's proportions within its moving viewport. Do not interpolate layout dimensions every frame or perform repeated layout reads during animation.

The car's expansion must preserve the entire vehicle and original geometry. Use a supported composited clipping approach; if the browser cannot maintain frame performance, use a transform/opacity reveal rather than repainting a large mask on every frame. No WebGL.

Serve responsive derivatives of the verified originals with intrinsic dimensions reserved. Phone targets are approximately 452px-wide lead portrait, 232px-wide work crops and 716 to 780px-wide vehicle image for 2× rendering; desktop selects larger derivatives only where displayed size warrants them. Preserve full-resolution sources for deliberate inspection.

Prioritize the lead portrait; eagerly resolve both adjacent work samples. Lazy-load continuation media and larger inspection derivatives. Target initial phone route media at or below 350KB where source quality permits; report any quality-driven exception. There is no autoplay video requirement.

Navigation and action state update on input, not after animation. Off-screen presentation stops. Mid-transition Close retargets the current visual state; it must not wait for the opening sequence to finish.

Store filter, selected work, originating record, scroll anchor and focus target independently from presentation progress. Browser Back closes the deepest viewer or task before leaving the parent route. Preserve local drafts and scenario state across route changes.

Use accessible icon-only Search, Messages and Notifications on phone, with 44px targets. All five primary navigation labels remain printed. Reuse the actual bundled icon set after repository inspection instead of introducing a competing family.

At 320 and 200% text zoom, let identity, controls and forms grow vertically. If the portrait/work pair cannot remain useful, place the selected work beneath the portrait. Never reduce required type, crop text or preserve the word budget through clipping.

Write actual visible-text counts to TEXT_COUNTS.md, material implementation to MATERIAL_SYSTEM.md and measured performance to PERFORMANCE.md. Extend REPORT.md with the real capture and recording paths only after the files exist.

spec.wow_moment: This surface carries the working-preview version of One part of a real car. Its proof is the photograph-to-plan-to-rate relationship, not zoom magnitude: Eli's untouched vehicle expands over 440ms, the separate rear-door diagram opens over 240ms, the supported zone fills over 160ms, and the US$240 /month Asking rate line settles 12px into that zone's opaque reading position over 220ms. The final composition rests completely still; return takes 280ms and restores the exact source anchor.

on_demand: Person inspection reveals only supported eligibility, completed-work facts, reviews and campaign context. Absence creates no empty badge or explanatory filler.
Request exposes the existing Story/Recreate type-specific requirements and complete review boundary. All exact field values, dates, financial bases and disclosures bind to the working fixture.

Vehicle inspection exposes the verified plan, supported zone and scope of the asking rate. Offer reveals actual booking requirements without inventing available dates, installation slots or accepted terms.
Business opens the supporting brand profile. Loyalty is its first operational row beneath identity; the single Settings gear remains there.
The existing Design Lab selector retains approved scenarios, Reset demo and the confirmation that scenario replacement resets local changes. It is not a product navigation destination.
The identity switcher contains Personal, the permitted business fixture and Add business. It changes only the isolated preview context and preserves each context's location.
Create retains exactly Recreate a Reel, Instagram Story ads and Car advertising. Open only implemented V3 previews; otherwise show the explicit inherited unavailable notice.
The live, no-program, draft and live-zero Loyalty entrances route directly to their existing working destinations. This surface does not redesign Loyalty's event model, program creation or counter.
Media provenance and implementation evidence belong in the V3 manifest and report, not repeated as captions beneath every person.
